description: This file defines an 'EchoBot' class that extends the 'ActivityHandler' from the botbuilder library. It implements methods to greet new members and echo back messages received in a chat context.

classes.name: EchoBot
classes.description: A simple echo bot that greets new members and echoes back message text.
